patch_description: Remove all circuit parameters and retain a single fixed CZ as the required non-empty block. Because the block is repeated six times, CZ^6 is exactly the identity, so the classifier directly uses the dataset-provided mean Z-Z correlator with only the trainable gain and bias. This reduces total parameters from 8 to 2, gate count from 138 to 6, and circuit depth substantially. The existing perfect accuracy and rapid convergence indicate that the fixed correlator readout already contains the class signal; eliminating unnecessary rotations should improve parameter efficiency, simulation speed, and resistance to overfitting.
